author: Bobby Grayson
description: Discovered by translating a hand-written root module with PubSub.subscribe in init/1: the output beh had the unsubscribe (me) but no subscription anywhere
title: Gap found while resuming and closed: a module whose init/1 subscribes but that nothing in the file spawns produced NO effect at all (silently), because the subscribe effect names the subscriber pid and the only place a child's pid is nameable is the parent's spawn site. The translator now scans the file for GenServer.start_link/start(Mod, _) and warns for each subscribing module that is never spawned; pubsub_root.ex is the fixture (first use of the runner's # warn: directive)
